complaints.narrative: Victim received counterfeit electricity disconnection warning with APK link. ₹95,000 debited via IMPS to Axis mule ACC-MULE-001, transferred within 18 minutes to L2 mule ACC-MULE-004.

complaints.transaction_location: Outer Ring Road Metro Station ATM
complaints.narrative: Telegram task completion scam. ₹1,42,000 deposited in 2 tranches into Federal mule ACC-MULE-002, layered to Yes Express L2 mule ACC-MULE-005.
Institutional trading group impersonation. Victim directed to transfer ₹2,10,000 to Kotak mule ACC-MULE-003, routed immediately to PNB L2 hub ACC-MULE-009.
Counterfeit utility bill payment SMS. Victim entered credentials on phishing portal; funds moved via ACC-MULE-001 to IndusInd mule ACC-MULE-006.
Illegal instant credit application harassment. Coerced transfer of ₹1,85,000 into Canara mule ACC-MULE-007, layered to ACC-MULE-006 within 12 minutes.
Fraudulent SIM replacement triggered unauthorized net-banking reset. ₹74,000 routed to ACC-MULE-002, subsequently consolidated at ACC-MULE-004.
